title: World Bloom — In an Ephemeral Embrace — Episode2 Everyday Life

meta.Event Outline: Several days before the meeting in the Asahina family household, the members of Nightcord at 25:00 notice something strange happening to the tree in their SEKAI. They each soon find themselves dreaming of very different lives.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Thank you for making breakfast again today, Kanade. This looks delicious.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. The omelets turned out really well today. Try them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: You made them sweet the other day, but these are much more savory. I'm impressed by your cooking skills, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I put some real effort in today.
Which do you like better, Dad?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I like everything that you make.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That doesn't help me at all.
I asked because I want to make what you like, Dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wait, Dad, you have bags under your eyes.
Did you stay up all night again?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Yes, I was planning to go to a good stopping point, and the next thing I knew, the sun was coming up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Dad...
Don't come crying to me if you get sick again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But... I know a lot of people are looking forward to your next song. Everyone says your music makes them happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to compose songs the way you do someday, Dad.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: But you'll need to study hard to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I know.
I have to learn as much as I can to broaden my skillset as a composer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I still don't like studying for tests...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Haha. Then, if you get good scores, I'll give you a reward.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, look at the time...
I need to get going.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: The passage you all just heard describes the characters' thoughts and feelings in very subtle ways.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Please take a minute now to write down what you think those thoughts and feelings were.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This part... She seemed really sad when she realized that her dream would never come true. But she was able to reunite with her friend, who she thought she'd never see again. So, she must be feeling happier than sad.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She hardly ever cries, but she was overcome with joy...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If I turned what she's feeling in this moment into a song...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki?
What are you writing there?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Kanade! Were you composing another song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I was...
A good melody popped into my head, so...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Haha! You just can't help it, can you?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Weren't you warned just the other day for doing the same thing?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I was...
I know I need to pay attention during class.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
But you come up with the most amazing songs!
I always feel better after listening to them.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yes, really. I always listen to them while walking over to school. Even if I'm feeling down, I'm all cheered up by the time I get here!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh yeah, the videos of your songs have tens of thousands of views, don't they?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't think that makes me famous or anything...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But it is nice to know that a lot of people are listening to my songs.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Hehe. You are always talking about how you want to make people happy through your songs just like your dad.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, but my songs still leave a lot to be desired.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Not true!
I mean, you've already made me happy♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How could I have forgotten my things? I knew we'd be meeting in a different classroom next...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I just told Dad that I'd do my best at school...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry!
I was spacing out...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Are you okay? You're not hurt, are you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? You know who I am?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm in the next class over, after all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's nice to meet you. My name is Mafuyu Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Y-Yes, nice to meet you too...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, next period is going to start soon. We'd better get going.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've heard her name before, but I didn't realize she knew who I was.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope I get to talk to her again.
